component: Enterprise policies and Privacy preferences visibility

quotes.text: // display:none, not hidden: the pane show/hide code overrides hidden.
The data collection settings section should be hidden by DisableDataCollectionSettings

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: DisableDataCollectionSettings calls the shared locking helper with the separate mail.data_collection_settings.enabled preference set false. Privacy initialization then hides both the category and group with display:none !important and skips reporting-control setup; pane search can otherwise reset hidden. The browser test directly sets the pref and asserts both nodes hidden, while separate policy-test data checks the pref value and lock state. This does not establish policy-to-render execution or a change to telemetry consent or submission behavior.
title: The data-collection policy controls the visibility of the Privacy settings section
